task.title: 验证 JSON 文档
task.shortdesc: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 JSON Editor 场景：验证 JSON 文档. Validate raw JSON syntax and Firefox policy values before saving.

prereq.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 JSON Editor 场景：验证 JSON 文档. Open JSON Editor with the document you want to check.

context.p: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 JSON Editor 场景：验证 JSON 文档. Validation distinguishes malformed JSON from policy or schema errors. A document can parse as JSON and still fail policy validation.

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 JSON Editor 场景：验证 JSON 文档. Choose the shared Validate action.

info.p: 预期结果：JSON Editor 保留配置文件上下文并显示可理解状态。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 JSON Editor 场景：验证 JSON 文档. If validation reports malformed JSON, fix syntax such as trailing commas or missing braces.

info.p: 预期结果：JSON Editor 保留配置文件上下文并显示可理解状态。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 JSON Editor 场景：验证 JSON 文档. If validation reports policy errors, correct unsupported keys, wrong value types, or schema-channel mismatches.

info.p: 预期结果：JSON Editor 保留配置文件上下文并显示可理解状态。

step.cmd: 本主题面向中文本地化完整说明 JSON Editor 场景：验证 JSON 文档. Validate again until the status explains that the document is acceptable or the remaining issue is intentional for raw review.

info.note: 警告：保存前请检查 JSON 语法、top-level policies 和策略验证错误。

result.p: JSON Editor 处于预期状态，并且该操作可在审查时解释。 The document has a known validation state before save or export.

postreq.p: 恢复：如果结果不符合预期，请验证文档、返回 All Settings 或打开相关主题。 Recovery: if errors are hard to read, use All Settings to inspect the affected policy or preference visually.
